title: Felt builtin: cell_property(zone, col, row, key) -> String
description: Add a cell_property builtin to Felt that reads cell properties from the game state. Signature: cell_property(zone: Zone, col: Int, row: Int, key: String) -> String. Returns the string value of the property, or empty string if not set. Needed for wargame terrain queries (movement_cost, defense_bonus, terrain type). Requires: checker.rs type registration, codegen.rs host import, felt_host.rs implementation.
close_reason: Added cell_property builtin to Felt checker, codegen, and server host. 127 Felt tests + 130 server tests pass.
